# fct_overrides_monthly

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_overrides_monthly` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Overrides are additional revenue Fora earns from supplier partners above & beyond the commission amounts. Each row represents a single account in a single month. Sourced from a Google Sheet managed by Finance, where they copy+paste values from our accounting software.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `account_name` | The name of the financial account the override revenue is tracked in, such as '410015 - Cruise Override Revenue' >> SOURCE - Google Sheet maintained by Finance |
| `override_monthly_id` | Primary Key, a hashed combination of the date and account name >> SOURCE - Google Sheet maintained by Finance data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `override_revenue_usd` | The amount of override revenue recorded for that month in that account, in USD  >> SOURCE - Google Sheet maintained by Finance |
| `revenue_date` | The month revenue was recognized for the override, represented as the first day of the month (e.g. '2025-11-01' for 'Nov 2025') >> SOURCE - Google Sheet maintained by Finance |
